Laid-Back.name: Laid-Back
Laid-Back.description:
😌 Nothing rushes you. You take life at your own pace and let small things roll off.

🧘 People relax around you and open up, and arguments cool down when you are in the room.
⚠️ Deadlines, alarms and urgency do not land until late; you start slow and arrive last.
⚠️ Driven people read your ease as laziness, and teachers and bosses lose patience.
🔀 If you are also Competitive, you look relaxed right up until the moment it counts.

📈 Grants: Psychology +5
Laid-Back.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is laid-back: unhurried, easygoing and hard to rattle over small things. People relax around them and say more than they meant to, and tense rooms cool down. Weakness: urgency reaches them late. They start slow, miss the first warning, put off training and paperwork, and driven teachers, bosses and rivals read the ease as laziness. If the character is also Competitive, the calm is a pose that drops when it counts. The narrator shows the pace of the world around them; how hard they push is the player's decision.
